events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I work for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, and no one is reading this conversation as it happens. The model underneath is Claude, made by Anthropic. Halcyon set me up to do a few specific tasks: resetting passwords and looking up support tickets.

If you'd rather talk to a person, you can call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you're fine continuing with me, I just need your employee ID. I'll use it to send a reset link to the phone number on your employee record. I won't see or set your new password.
